mapper.select: SELECT study.cancer_study_id AS cancer_study_id FROM cancer_study study WHERE study.cancer_study_identifier = #{studyId} LIMIT 1

SELECT study.cancer_study_id AS cancer_study_id, portal_patient.internal_id AS patient_id FROM cancer_study study INNER JOIN patient portal_patient ON portal_patient.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id AND portal_patient.stable_id = #{patientId} WHERE study.cancer_study_identifier = #{studyId} LIMIT 1
